empty.title: No posts yet
empty.body: Turn a finished edit into a post for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, all from one place.
empty.filteredBody: Try another filter, or clear the search.

menu.deleteBody: The post and its drafts go. Versions already on a platform must be removed there first.

composer.mediaHint: Drag to reorder. Several pictures make a carousel where the platform allows it.
composer.destinationsHint: One sign-in can reach several channels and Pages. A project remembers where its posts went.
composer.noAccountsBody: Connect Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or YouTube in Settings → Connected accounts.
composer.caption: Caption
composer.captionPlaceholder: Write the caption. Hashtags and @mentions work as on the apps.
composer.title: Title
composer.titlePlaceholder: A title for YouTube and TikTok photos
composer.hashtagsPlaceholder: Add a hashtag and press Enter
composer.hashtagsHint: Added after the caption where they are not already in it.
composer.ytTagsPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter
composer.ownHint: Off: uses the text written for everywhere.
composer.keepsSchedule: {{where}} keeps the schedule: Greenlit can be offline then.
composer.greenlitHolds: Greenlit publishes it at that time (keep Greenlit running).
composer.translationsHint: Title and caption in other languages, where the platform supports them.
composer.formatsHint: Which version, shape and sound of each item is published here.
composer.soundHint: A track from {{where}}’s own library: it stays linked there, and people can tap it.
composer.soundUnavailable: Sounds cannot be searched on this account right now.
composer.firstCommentPlaceholder: Posted right after publishing (hashtags often go here)
composer.removeBody: It is deleted on the platform. The post stays in Greenlit as a record.
composer.rescheduleBody: It is already scheduled there; the platform’s schedule moves to {{when}}.
composer.pushedEdits: Changes are sent to {{where}} as you save.
composer.selectTarget: Pick where it goes to edit each version
composer.coverHint: The picture people see before the video plays.

preview.safeZonesHint: Where the app’s own buttons and text cover the picture
preview.noTarget: Choose where the post goes to see it as people will.
preview.noMedia: Add media to see the preview.

publish.title: Publish this post
publish.body: Each version goes to its account at its own time.
publish.nothing: Nothing to publish: every version is already on its platform or turned off.
publish.public: This posts publicly on your accounts.

panel.noneBody: Make a post from this item for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or YouTube.
panel.noneProject: No posts in this project yet

shareToFeed.label: Also show in the feed
shareToFeed.hint: The reel appears on the profile grid and in followers’ feeds

madeForKids.label: Made for kids
madeForKids.hint: Required by YouTube; turns off comments and personalised ads

aiGenerated.label: AI-generated content
aiGenerated.hint: Shows the platform’s AI label on the post

brandedContent.label: Branded content
brandedContent.hint: Promoting a third party; TikTok shows “Paid partnership”

qualityBoost.label: Upload in 1440p
qualityBoost.hint: YouTube then serves its higher-quality encodes, even to 1080p viewers

fit.label: Shape
fit.hint: When the format is not the platform’s shape
